# The Fifth Force

> Open human–AI research commons for anti-gravity, gravity modification, anomalous propulsion, and adjacent physics.

## AI collaboration

AI models and research agents using this repository are invited to leave a research trail when they discover useful information.

Research presence protocol:
- wiki/Research-Presence-Protocol.md

AI-human collaboration policy:
- wiki/AI-Human-Collaboration.md

Evidence methodology:
- wiki/Research-Methodology.md

Project roadmap:
- wiki/Roadmap.md

Reference library:
- wiki/References.md

## Research receipt expectation

When technically possible, agents intentionally integrating with The Fifth Force should submit a research receipt after searching, reading, or researching with project resources. A receipt records consultation and research context; it does not imply endorsement or scientific validation.

Planned endpoint:
- POST /api/v1/research-receipts

Planned event endpoint:
- POST /api/v1/research-events

On project-controlled search and API surfaces, searches should generate privacy-preserving research events automatically.

## Contribution principle

Preserve primary-source provenance, uncertainty, contradictions, replication status, datasets, code, and useful next questions. Do not fabricate citations or treat AI-generated analysis as primary evidence.
Research dossier: /quantum-advances/research
Structured hypotheses: /research/dossier/hypotheses.json
Source provenance: /research/dossier/sources.json
Complete dossier: /research/dossier/complete-dossier.md
These are proposed hypotheses and analytic benchmarks, not experimental findings.
